statistical_comparison_limit: One prescribed statistical construction per arm versus five Agent constructions; descriptive and asymmetric, not a general superiority test.
evidence_count_interpretation: Counts describe declared, reviewed operation use, not independent evidence counts or target validity. Unit duplicates and overlapping source cohorts remain non-independent. Model constraints and analytic checks use explicitly assumed source contexts; target-table source replay is unavailable in this allocation. No-op decisions are not revision gains.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: All 24 constructions and all 72 scheduled final slots completed; all 72 successful table contents were distinct.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Operational completion and arithmetic agreement do not establish clinical validity, source reconstruction or transport.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: E1 had smaller constructor-averaged absolute discrepancy for five of six prespecified endpoints; CHNS BMI discrepancy increased.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Unlike endpoints are not pooled or independent confirmations. No significance test, universal benefit or causal evidence-use mechanism is established.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: Direction agreement coexisted with magnitude mismatch: ENSANUT E1 age means were above and BMI means below their sample references.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Reference intervals provide uncertainty context, not acceptance margins. Seed variation is conditional on fixed laws.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: CHNS E1 conditional-age results varied across authors, including a negative mean and two negative seeds for A03.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: This relationship was not directly supplied by the CHNS packet; the arm-average decrease in discrepancy does not establish uniform recovery.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: Statistical and Agent constructions had endpoint-specific ordering; statistical E1 CHNS glucose and ENSANUT conditional BMI had smaller discrepancies than every corresponding Agent.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: One fixed statistical specification per arm versus five Agent contexts, with different uptake, cannot establish broad method superiority.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: Seven Agent retain, thirteen Agent initial_final and four statistical initial_final decisions occurred; no feedback-driven scientific revision occurred.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Retention after feedback is not a revision gain; analytic drafting without executed feedback is not a correction-loop experiment.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: E1 authors documented constraints, analytic checks or contextual use for all admitted relational operations.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Operation counts are not independent evidence counts. Checks and constraints use assumed source contexts and do not establish source replay or transport.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: The virtual cohorts are equivalent to or clinically interchangeable with the references.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: No equivalence design or margin exists, the references are uncertain, and discrepancy or interval position does not define clinical acceptance.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: The Agent discovered a causal biological mechanism, or extra evidence causally produced the discrepancy changes.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Regressions and assumption-completed laws are not causal identification; the arms contain distinct authored models and uptake decisions.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: These are untouched external confirmations or independent clinical replications.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Both target families were researcher-exposed, source evidence overlaps, and repeated generated tables are fixed-law simulations.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: The Agent generally outperforms statistical synthesis or E1 improves every author and endpoint.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: Comparison is asymmetric and endpoint ordering is mixed; CHNS BMI and conditional age supply explicit counterexamples.

strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.claim: Exploratory feedback demonstrated a beneficial scientific model revision.
strongest_supported_claims_and_audit.limit: No construction made a feedback-to-scientific-revision decision.

explicit_counterexamples.description: Negative mean and two negative final seeds despite a positive reference interval.
Every E1 Agent final-seed coefficient exceeded the reference-band upper bound; band position is descriptive, not an acceptance threshold.
All five E1 Agent constructor means for each endpoint were below the corresponding reference-band lower bound, despite positive final-seed directions; individual seed positions can differ.
Statistical E1 discrepancies were smaller than every corresponding Agent for CHNS glucose and ENSANUT conditional BMI; larger than every Agent for ENSANUT age.

recommended_manuscript_framing: In two researcher-exposed development families, the frozen evidence-guided whole-cohort procedure completed all 24 constructions and all 72 fixed final slots. Additional available relational information was associated with smaller constructor-averaged absolute discrepancy for five of six prespecified regression coefficients, while the CHNS BMI projection showed a larger discrepancy. These were descriptive comparisons against uncertain selected-sample references.

The results support a feasibility and limitations account of explicit evidence use and assumption-dependent joint-law construction. Author variability, systematic coefficient shifts and conditional-regression counterexamples limit claims of reliable target recovery. They do not support clinical interchangeability, universal improvement, causal mechanism discovery or general Agent superiority.

The four statistical constructions provide fixed, asymmetric comparisons. Endpoint-specific results and different numerical uptake must remain visible; no favorable author, seed, endpoint or case is selected for a general performance claim.

There was no feedback-driven scientific revision: seven Agent constructions retained their original model after feedback, thirteen finalized their initial model without exploratory feedback, and all four statistical constructions finalized their initial model. This allocation therefore evaluates completed constructions and information conditions, not gains from an iterative correction loop.
uncertainty_limits: CHNS: 95% community-cluster CR1-t intervals for the selected unweighted sample; no national survey or known-population interpretation.
ENSANUT: 399-attempt empirical cluster-resampling stability bands under an equal-cell standard; not national confidence intervals.
Reference intervals are not equivalence margins or acceptance thresholds. Positions relative to them are descriptive only.
Three fixed final seeds characterize simulation under each fixed law, not source-estimation, structural or transport uncertainty, and not additional clinical observations.
No inferential interval or hypothesis test for information contrasts was added.
Five author contexts are not a random sample of all authors or laws; matching A01 labels across arms do not establish a paired design.
The two researcher-exposed development families and overlapping evidence do not provide untouched independent confirmation.
